Short excerpts of open guitar strings, used by `test/tuner_test.dart`
to check pitch detection on real recordings.

Source: [tonejs-instruments](https://github.com/nbrosowsky/tonejs-instruments)
by Nicholaus P. Brosowsky (`samples/guitar-acoustic/E2.wav`,
`samples/guitar-nylon/G3.wav`), licensed
[CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Trimmed to the
first three (E2) and two (G3) seconds.
